english.title: Fail to give inspector acting in execution of Horse Passport Regulations 2009 required assistance / information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable cause, failed to give to **(..SPECIFY INSPECTOR..), an inspector acting in the execution of the Horse Passports Regulations 2009, assistance or information reasonably required by

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

under those regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 21(b) and 22 of the Horse Passports Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: For the current legislation, please see regulation 30 of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
